results.text: G45 and V386 in Transmembrane Domains 1 and 8 Are Critical for the Activation of OATP1B3-Mediated E17βG Uptake by Clotrimazole. Organic anion-transporting polypeptides (OATPs) 1B1 and 1B3 are two highly homologous transport proteins. However, OATP1B1- and 1B3-mediated estradiol-17β-glucuronide (E17βG) uptake can be differentially affected by clotrimazole.
